# EnterpriseClaw AI — enterpriseclawai.com

**EnterpriseClaw AI** is the enterprise tier of the Claw AI family: the same product suite (sales, security, services, tools, deployment) with the controls a regulated organization needs — EU-only hosting, SSO/SAML, exportable audit logs, custom models, org-wide governance and a 99.9% SLA.

## Product
- EU-only hosting, per-tenant isolation, no cross-border data moves
- SSO (Google/SAML), per-product roles, one-click offboarding
- Immutable audit logs, SIEM export, retention 90 days – 7 years
- Custom / dedicated models; never used to train shared models
- Org-wide spend caps, model allow-lists, kill switches
- 99.9% SLA (Standard+), named engineer, incident reports in 24 h
- Private-cloud / on-prem option (Enterprise plan)

## Plans (EUR, PROPOSED)
| Plan | Price | Includes |
|---|---|---|
| Starter | €490/mo | 1 team, 5 agents, Google SSO, 90-day audit, business-hours support |
| Standard | €1,490/mo | 5 teams, 25 agents, SAML, 13-month audit + SIEM, governance, 99.9% SLA |
| Enterprise | Custom | unlimited, custom/dedicated models, private cloud/on-prem, custom SLA |
